profile.name: MiniLas Evo 激光器
profile.description: 一款紧凑型实验室激光光源，用于光学对准、样品激发、照明和一般激光实验。设备支持功率调节，并可读取发射波长、温度、状态和累计运行时间等信息。
profile.description_en: A compact laboratory laser source used for optical alignment, sample excitation, illumination, and general laser experiments. The device supports power adjustment and provides information such as emission wavelength, temperature, status, and total operating hours.
